Welcome aboard

The station goes round the Earth every 92 minutes.

Six people live here, with a greenhouse full of tomatoes.

About the Station

Five space agencies built the station together in 2031, and every one of them still sends crew.

Orbital Station 7
Docking Ring B
Low Earth Orbit

On board: a gym, a greenhouse and a telescope.
